decision.reason: The only evidence, [ev-8f8896a282cf], is a release-note line saying an E2E test (TestCrossplaneLifecycle) was made to pass. It names no product configuration, API, permission or runtime behaviour, and says nothing fails, is rejected or must be migrated. On its face this is a test-only change, so "none" (informational, low) fits what the evidence states. Confidence is low because the line doesn't say whether the linked PR also changed product code.
